data.description: Get a great haircut for $8.99  only at Great Clips Bay Forest at 1926 El Dorado Boulevard in Houston.  To redeem the offer now, click “Redeem Now” and present this offer on your phone at the time of payment. To redeem the offer later, just enter your email and click “Save for Later”.
data.terms_and_conditions: Valid only at Great Clips Bay Forest at 1926 El Dorado Boulevard in Houston, TX. Not valid with any other offer. Limit one coupon per customer. No copies. Taxes may apply. Expires 05/14/2026. All Great Clips® salons are independently owned and operated.
